issues.title: Autoresponder email not sent to form leads
issues.problem_statement: Leads were coming in from the customer's form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

issues.title: Sender domain verification to avoid spam
issues.problem_statement: Support noted that autoresponder emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying the sender domain would be good.

items.description: Customer turned on the autoresponder option, which support saw was off, in the form settings and saved it, following support's guidance; a test form filled in from the customer's other email address then delivered the email, and the customer confirmed it is working correctly now.
evidence: भर दिया... हाँ, ईमेल आ गया! अब सही चल रहा है।

items.description: Support explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying the sender domain is a good idea, and that this can be done in the email domain part of the settings.
evidence: ईमेल कभी-कभी स्पैम में जा सकता है, इसलिए सेंडर डोमेन वेरिफ़ाई कर लेना अच्छा रहेगा।

items.description: Customer will verify the sender domain in the email domain part of the settings.
